title: Radiant Nuclear statement band
description: A window-high, full-bleed looping video (capped at 1100px) with one short bold all-caps statement in the top-left corner. As the band slides up to fill the screen, the statement's lines rise out of their masks and fade in, one after another.
notes: sized by the window (100svh, at most 1100px); the video is cropped to it like object-fit: cover
type is set in the theme's card colour over a foreground gradient (foreground over a background gradient in dark mode), so it needs a theme whose foreground and card contrast
the line reveal is CSS scroll-driven; without support or with reduced motion the statement simply shows
